text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, let us begin with catching 
practice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"First, we will check the proper catching 
form. 
After that, we'll internalize it through 
playing catch."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"There are two points to keep in mind when 
catching. 
The first is not to try and catch the ball 
with just your hands."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Always receive the ball at the center of 
your body, imagining 
yourself pulling it into both arms the 
instant it makes contact."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The second point is to keep your elbows 
tucked in while catching so the ball 
doesn't slip out. In other 
words—Bourbon-san, if you would."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order confirmed. Here I go—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Hup.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"As shown, it doesn't need to be a fast 
throw at first. 
Please practice with a priority on 
maintaining proper form."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we begin—
(*Thwack!* *Thwack!*)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right! I think I'm starting 
to get the hang of catching it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, me too! It's all thanks to 
Ikuno-chan's coaching. 
Though at the start, we had to begin by 
learning the rules from scratch—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"True to its name, Oni Dodgeball is a 
sport 
that fuses tag with dodgeball."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike regular dodgeball, players do not 
split into separate territories; 
instead, allies and opponents mingle 
across the entire court."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, there is no concept of being 
'out' or an 'outfield.' 
The winner is decided by the points earned 
from hitting opponents with the ball."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Additionally, each team consists of two 
Oni Generals and three Foot Soldiers. 
A ball thrown by an Oni earns 2 points, 
double that of a Foot Soldier."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise, once you have the ball, you 
chase down opponents and throw it at them. 
Movement requires dribbling, and foul 
types are mostly identical to 
basketball—in summary."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I definitely understand the general 
rules, but... 
I still can't quite picture how we're 
actually supposed to move out there~."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I concur with Tannhauser-san. 
Estimating it will be difficult to secure 
victory based purely on understanding the 
rules."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be fine! In the end, the team with 
whoever 
runs the fastest and throws the hardest is 
bound to be the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I see... However, winning a race requires 
'skills' and 'technique' 
in addition to basic physical stamina."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I infer these requirements can be 
substituted in other sports as well. 
The fact that they remain undefined is 
likely due to our lack of learning."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's true. Right now, we have no idea 
whether we're strong or weak, 
or what we even can or can't do."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. I anticipated that such 
questions 
would arise, so I have already made 
preparations."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Oooh! As expected of Ikuno! 
So, what kind of preparations did you 
make?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"As they say: 'If you know the enemy and 
know yourself, you need not fear the 
result of a hundred battles.' 
I have arranged a practice match. Starting 
right after this."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaaaat~~?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"BWAHAHAHA! 
Are you the ones who wish to have a 
practice match with us?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for taking the time to 
meet with us! 
We're complete beginners, so please teach 
us a lot♪"

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! Think nothing of it, a practice 
match 
is welcome for our side as well. Let's 
make it a good game!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Team 'Penta' is a powerhouse regarded as 
a top contender for the championship. 
Today, let us be sure to closely observe 
their fighting style."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"A-A championship contender is our 
opponent?! Isn't that raising the bar way 
too high for our first time?!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"No. If our objective is experiential 
learning, 
the higher the skill of the target, the 
more benefit we will gain."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Bourbon-san says, that is 
precisely the intent. 
That being said, everyone, let us ensure 
above all else that we avoid injury."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Wait... Injury...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Are you really sure you want us to start 
with the ball? 
Well then, we won't hold back—Baku-chan, 
here it comes!"

text_block_list.name: Penta Member
text_block_list.text:
"Right, intercepted! 
Pass it around, pass it around—Captain, 
take the first lead~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Waaaaahhhhh...?!"

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Too slow! That's the first 2 points on the 
board!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Byaaaaahhhhh!!! No way, no way, no 
waaaay~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Cannot analyze. Completely exceeds 
predicted values. 
Data correction required."

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, nice dodge! 
But we're just getting started... 
Hyaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Nwaaaah, my forehead! My precious class 
rep forehead! 
Isn't it scorched?! It's totally scorched, 
isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, there is no need to force 
yourselves to catch it. 
For now, just focus on dodging and getting 
used to the ball's momentum!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"D-D-D-Dodge it?! Right! All I gotta do is 
dodge! 
I'll be fine as long as I don't get hit... 
But still, this is way too scary~~!"

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! You can't play a game if all 
you do is run away, can you?! 
Take this!"

text_block_list.name: Machitan's Group
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaahhh!!!
